# Code City Blue: Beta Distribution

Welcome to the defensive iteration of the Code City ecosystem. 

## 📦 Package Contents
- `molt/`: Self-mutating agent engine (Refactored/Pristine).
- `janebot/`: MotherBrain orchestration.
- `health_dashboard.py`: Real-time integrity visualization.

## 🚀 Deployment Guide
1. Ensure your environment variables are configured.
2. Initialize with `python main.py`.
3. Monitor system integrity via `health_dashboard.py`.

*Report bugs via the /bug command.*
